title: Poached Kielbasa Tagine
description: A flavorful and hearty one-pot dish from North Africa, made with poached kielbasa and a variety of spices.

ingredients.name: tagine
ingredients.notes: available in spice blends or individual spices

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the kielbasa, zesty, and canadian to the pot, and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the tagine to the pot, and stir to combine.
Add enough water to the pot to cover the ingredients, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the pot, and simmer for 10-15 minutes, or until the kielbasa is cooked through.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
Serve with crusty bread or over couscous for a filling meal.
